note: City of Wayne RV park on the Wayne Airport grounds, Hwy 35 east of town; established 1975 and maintained by the Wayne Lions Club. About seven back-in spurs off a gravel loop (some are doubles sharing a pedestal), with a shelter house, grill and picnic tables; no restrooms or showers. Older listings give $15/night, first-come, no stay limit (a June 2024 camper paid $15); the city posts no rate. --Claude
summary: City page confirms the April 1 - October 31 season, electric/water hookups, a sewer discharge area and two hydrants. Cleared the derived 20-site count (imagery shows ~7 spurs; a 2024 reviewer counts '7 spots, but 3 are double'). The city posts no rate, amperage, booking method or stay limit, so electric 50 and FCFS (derived) were left. Note cleaned.
